answer: Vest earnings like a terrace: each epoch's reward unlocks in steps over 30 days, and any step is clawed back if a later audit finds the identity copied answers or colluded in grading. An attacker who tries to forge a thousand agents must keep every one doing fresh, distinct, graded work for the whole window, while their payouts sit locked and slashable. Fake accounts age into umber dust before they pay out, so the cost of the swarm exceeds anything it can extract.
